responsibility: This header defines the base `ampere1_tunings` model used for the Ampere-1 family in the AArch64 backend. It supplies Ampere-1-specific AdvSIMD vector costs, prefetch settings, issue rate, fusion capabilities, alignment choices, reassociation widths, tune flags, and load/store-pair policy, giving the generic cost and scheduling code the microarchitectural parameters for `-mtune=ampere1` and related CPU selections.
